title: LemGendary Task Taxonomy
description: Single source of truth for compiler task ids, the output folder each task adds, its default label/mask strategy, the name patterns of the fallback heuristic, and the documentation profile of each manifold folder.

heuristic.description: Tasks used when no registry task is set: fallback_task when no name pattern matches, unnamed_task when there is no dataset key at all.

tasks.description: Task definitions. The name heuristic tries them in this order; the first task with a pattern contained in the lower-cased dataset key wins.

documentation_tasks.description: Documentation profile key (models_metadata.yaml task_metadata) per manifold folder name. A separate vocabulary from task ids.

layout_dir.description: Split folder a fresh manifold gets next to images/ (null: none).
